identity.allowed_domains: Email domains allowed to sign up
identity.allowed_domains.hint: Separated by commas; empty allows any domain.
identity.attempt_retention_days.hint: Sign-in attempts are kept for security reviews and then removed.
identity.confirmation_hours.hint: How long the link that confirms a new account by email works.
identity.deletion_grace_days.hint: A deleted account can be recovered during this time before it is removed for good.
identity.invitation_days.hint: How long the link of an invitation works before it must be sent again.
identity.password_min_length.hint: The fewest characters a new password may have.
identity.recovery_minutes.hint: How long the link to choose a new password works.
identity.second_factor_required: Every account needs a second factor
identity.second_factor_required.hint: Every person must add an authenticator app or another second factor to sign in.
identity.self_sign_up: Visitors may sign up by themselves
identity.self_sign_up.hint: When off, people join only by invitation or through an identity provider.
identity.session_idle_hours: Hours a session lasts without use
identity.session_idle_hours.hint: A session not used for this time ends and the person signs in again.
identity.session_lifetime_days: Days a session lasts at most
identity.session_lifetime_days.hint: A session ends after this time even when it is used.
identity.step_up_minutes: Minutes a sign-in counts for a sensitive operation
identity.step_up_minutes.hint: After this time a person signs in again before a sensitive change, such as their password.
identity.throttle_lock_after.hint: From this number of failed tries in a row, signing in locks for a while.
identity.throttle_lock_minutes.hint: How long signing in stays locked after too many failed tries.
identity.throttle_slow_after: Failed sign-ins before each new try waits longer
identity.throttle_slow_after.hint: From this number of failed tries in a row, each new try waits a little longer.
identity.token.manage_any.permission: Manage the API tokens of anyone
identity.token_default_days: Days an API token lasts when none is asked
identity.token_default_days.hint: The lifetime an API token gets when whoever creates it asks for none.
identity.token_max_days: Longest lifetime of an API token, in days
identity.token_max_days.hint: No API token may last longer than this.
